name: DiscountApprovalGuard
tagline: Discount Approval Guard is the box where a sales rep enters the discount on a quote or opportunity line.
description: Discount Approval Guard is the box where a sales rep enters the discount on a quote or opportunity line. As soon as a value is entered it shows who has to approve it, the net price and the margin, and it stops discounts that break your policy - above the maximum or below the margin floor.
features: Quick presets and a policy track with self-approve
A maximum discount and an optional margin floor
Shows net unit price, net total
Tells the rep who has to approve
Writes the discount % to a bound number column and raises OnChange / OnApprovalLevelChange
